body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Dai Kyung Vascom, Korean retailer of Sennheiser, is presenting hi-fi stereo headset ''HD212PRO'' for DJs. The ''HD212PRO'' is designed for DJs with excellent noise reduction function, accommodating leather ear pads and powerful base sound.
